verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API for assigning users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases, and separately supports cohort/property-based user grouping, but the evidence doesn't show these combined into a unified flag-targeting system with percentage rollouts, cohort targeting, and property targeting configured together. missing for 10: documentation showing percentage-based rollout configuration, explicit cohort-based flag targeting, UI/SDK details for combining property + cohort + percentage rules in one flag, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
